decisive_items: progressive, multiple itchy erythematous to violaceous papules and plaques
lichenified papules and plaques on the left shin
novel heterozygous missense variant, c.6832G>T, p.Gly2278Trp, in COL7A1 (NM_000094)
response.rationale: Clinical presentation of chronic pruritic lichenified plaques on the shin with milia and erosions, plus COL7A1 mutation, strongly supports epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa, a subtype of dystrophic EB. R3 is the broader category but lacks the pruriginosa-specific phenotype.

rejected.why: Too broad; inherited EB includes many subtypes, less specific than pruriginosa.
Generic EB label; does not capture the pruriginosa phenotype or COL7A1 specificity.
Acquired form (EBA) contradicted by genetic COL7A1 variant indicating inherited disease.
